Welcome everyone. We are here to finalize the production rollout plan for Solvay Freight Logistics as your 25-seat Vortigen Cloud pilot wraps up on November 30, 2026.

[Nolan Becker] 10:15:18
Thanks, Talia. The pilot went well with our dispatchers, and we are ready to scope the full 210-seat deployment starting January 15, 2027.

[Gideon Marsh] 10:15:31
Glad to hear the routing automation hit your targets, Nolan. Did you have any technical open items from the pilot evaluation?

[Nolan Becker] 10:15:44
Technically the platform is solid, provided automated SAML single sign-on and directory sync are included. Our security policy forbids manual password administration for more than 50 users.

[Talia Harker] 10:16:02
On the initial quote we sent over on November 12, 2026, 210 seats at list price of $42 per seat per month came to $105,840 annually, plus the $6,500 Enterprise Onboarding package.

[Nolan Becker] 10:16:19

[Nolan Becker] 10:16:33
Second, you quoted directory provisioning as a $4,200 annual add-on, and we need our total first-year outlay under $96,000 to fit the approved Q1 2027 capital allocation.

[Talia Harker] 10:16:51

At $38 per seat per month for 210 seats, that equals $7,980 per month or $95,760 for the year. That lands right inside our $96,000 ceiling.

Nov 18, 2026
CinderPeak Retail / LatticePulse Commercial Review - Transcript
00:00:00

Soren Lindqvist: Thanks for meeting this afternoon, Hannah. Following Tuesday's technical sign-off, I wanted to review the commercial structure for deploying LatticePulse across CinderPeak Retail's 12 regional merchandising teams.

Hannah Thorne: Happy to dive in, Soren. We validated that we need 140 seats going live on February 1, 2027, ahead of our spring inventory planning cycle.

Soren Lindqvist: Great. On the initial proposal, 140 seats at our standard tier of $75 per seat per month totaled $10,500 per month, or $126,000 for the 12-month term.

Hannah Thorne: That brings up two hurdles. First, $75 per seat is above the $69 target our finance partner modeled when we compared vendors in October.

Hannah Thorne: Second, and even more critical, our remaining Q4 2026 budget allocation is capped at $25,000. If you require full $126,000 upfront payment upon signing in December, we would have to delay signing until late January.

Soren Lindqvist: Delaying signature until late January would squeeze your February 1, 2027 launch window because data warehouse mapping takes three weeks.

Hannah Thorne: Exactly. We want our sandbox connectors running by December 21, 2026 so our merchandising leads can train in January, but we cannot disburse more than $25,000 before April 1, 2027.

00:05:00

Soren Lindqvist: What if we structure a split billing schedule tied to a December 15, 2026 contract signature and reduce the per-seat price to $68.75 per seat per month?

Hannah Thorne: What does $68.75 per seat come out to over the full year for 140 seats?

Soren Lindqvist: That brings the annual contract value down from $126,000 to $115,500, saving you $10,500. We would invoice only $24,000 upon signature on December 15, 2026, and invoice the remaining $91,500 on April 1, 2027.

Hannah Thorne: And would we still get full sandbox and connector access starting December 18, 2026 without paying for the January pre-launch period?

Soren Lindqvist: Yes, I will commit to granting 45 days of complimentary pre-launch access from December 18, 2026 through January 31, 2027, with the paid 12-month subscription running February 1, 2027 to January 31, 2028.

Hannah Thorne: That solves both the unit rate and the Q4 cash flow constraint. I commit to sending our vendor onboarding packet to deals@latticepulse.example by November 23, 2026 and executing the order form by December 14, 2026.

Soren Lindqvist: Fantastic. I will email the updated order form with the $24,000 / $91,500 split billing schedule to hannah.thorne@cinderpeak-retail.example this afternoon.

Transcription ended after 00:09:42

Call Title: Orchid Financial Group - FY27 Enterprise Renewal Review
Date: November 18, 2026 14:00 UTC

Evelyn, thanks for taking the time today. I know our December 31, 2026 renewal is six weeks out and you flagged some concerns in your email on Monday.

Yes, Jovan. To be transparent, we are currently paying $144,000 per year for 200 seats of QuarryStream Data, which is $60 per seat per month, and my CTO asked me to evaluate a competing vendor.

[00:01:12] Jovan Mercer:
Let me address the reliability point first. Since we migrated Orchid Financial to an isolated single-tenant worker cluster on October 2, 2026, your connector uptime has been 99.994 percent.

Yes, provided we receive the signed renewal order form by December 8, 2026. I commit to delivering the redlined SLA addendum and $120,000 net quote to esato@orchid-financial.example by November 20, 2026.

Lukas Brenner [00:04]:
Guten Tag, Frau Voigt. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich heute Zeit nehmen, um die Vertragsverlängerung für Nordlicht Maschinenbau vor dem Ablaufdatum am 15. Januar 2027 zu besprechen.

Katrin Voigt [00:16]:
Hallo Herr Brenner. Wir haben intern mit der Konstruktionsleitung gesprochen, weil wir im Januar unser neues Werk in Rostock anbinden wollen.

Lukas Brenner [00:27]:
Das freut mich zu hören. Aktuell umfasst Ihr Vertrag 150 Lizenzen von KronosWerk Cloud zu je 48 Euro pro Lizenz und Monat, also 86.400 Euro im Jahr.

Katrin Voigt [00:40]:
Genau. Mit dem neuen Standort benötigen wir 75 zusätzliche Zugänge, also insgesamt 225 Lizenzen ab dem 15. Januar 2027.

Katrin Voigt [00:52]:
Allerdings haben wir zwei Einwände gegen das Standardangebot: Erstens fordern wir bei 225 Lizenzen einen Mengenrabatt auf maximal 42 Euro pro Lizenz, und zweitens akzeptiert unser Finanzvorstand keine vollständige Jahresvorauszahlung über 100.000 Euro im Januar.

Lukas Brenner [01:11]:
Ich verstehe beide Punkte, Frau Voigt. Bei einer Erhöhung von 150 auf 225 Lizenzen erreichen Sie unsere Enterprise-Staffel ab 200 Nutzern.

Katrin Voigt [01:23]:
